comment: Evaluator code (D31 rule 9, BT-081): outside the AI analyst's writable tree and view. The analyst sandbox (section 12) must not mount these paths, and assistant code must not import these modules. tests/python/test_evaluator_isolation.py enforces the import rule and that every path exists. The optimizer's gate and holdout modules are evaluator code too (ADR-0039, ADR-0040); the assistant talks to the optimizer only over gRPC.
